title: WearOS entered treatments from Pixel Watch not received by Pixel7 phone (no confirmation)
symptom: Commands sent from WearOS watch to phone work only for a short period after starting the AAPS app on the watch, then stop being received by the phone and no confirmation appears on the watch. Restarting the watch app temporarily restores functionality.
cause: WearOS is killing the AAPS app on the watch when it is not actively used, especially when not using an AAPS watchface.
fix: Use an AAPS watchface (e.g., AAPS(DigitalStyle)) to keep the app running and allow commands to work consistently.
evidence_quote: only way is to use AAPS watchface, I even tried to force keep running the aaps watch app but still the same problem, maybe wearOS is killing it if watchface is not used?
